name: NRC Industrial Research Assistance Program (NRC IRAP)

summary.quote: NRC IRAP provides funding to support the research and development of innovative, technology-driven products and services, and other innovation activities to help your business grow, create jobs, and compete globally.

research.notes: Type: the page says IRAP provides "funding" and "project funding" but never says whether it is repayable or not, so funding_types is empty (Unknown), as the lead asked. No amount, cost share or intake on the page; funding comes after advice and referrals ("This relationship typically starts with advice and referrals before any funding is provided"). Structure: "be incorporated, for-profit" plus the explicit exclusion list gives corporation only; a non-profit is not for-profit and a co-op is excluded by name. ULCs and LLCs are corporations the profile cannot tell apart, so they are a check-yourself item. Purpose research: the funding sentence is about research and development of technology-driven products; "Non-technical or purely commercial activities" are not funded. Location: "operating in Canada", met by every NL community. The phone is on the page and is for "a senior executive from your business" once you meet the minimum requirements.
